doThis: Keep displacement under 2px so it reads as feedback not motion
dontDoThis: Don't animate layout-affecting props (width/height/margin) on hover

doThis: Pair with a matching mouseleave tween that reverses the same properties
dontDoThis: Don't leave the hover state stuck if the pointer leaves fast; always attach the reverse tween

doThis: Clamp the pull strength (e.g. * 0.3) so the element never fully leaves its hit box
dontDoThis: Don't apply magnetic effect to more than 1-2 focal elements per screen; it becomes noisy

doThis: Keep the y offset small (8-16px) so it reads as a fade, not a slide
dontDoThis: Don't reveal below-the-fold content needed for SEO/crawlers as invisible-by-default without a no-JS fallback

doThis: Scope the ScrollTrigger to the section container so it doesn't re-scan the whole page
dontDoThis: Don't stagger more than ~8 children; beyond that the last items feel laggy

doThis: Use scrub: true or a small number (0.5-1.5) instead of instant jumps so it feels tied to the scrollbar
dontDoThis: Don't pin more than 1-2 sections per page; excessive pinning fights native scroll feel and hurts mobile UX

doThis: Keep per-item stagger delay small (0.02-0.04s) for lists longer than 10 items
dontDoThis: Don't stagger by more than 0.1s per item on long lists; total reveal time becomes sluggish

doThis: Combine with from: 'center' for a bento-grid layout to draw the eye inward first
dontDoThis: Don't use back.out on dense data tables; the overshoot reads as sloppy on informational UI

doThis: Revert SplitText on unmount/cleanup (split.revert()) to restore original text nodes for accessibility tools
dontDoThis: Don't split-animate long paragraphs; reserve for short headlines (under ~8 words)

doThis: Preload the destination route's critical assets before the exit tween finishes
dontDoThis: Don't block navigation on animation; cap exit duration at ~250ms so the app never feels unresponsive

doThis: Show a lightweight loading indicator if the destination route's data fetch outlasts the overlay
dontDoThis: Don't tie the overlay's reveal directly to data-fetch completion without a max-wait timeout; a slow API stalls the whole transition

doThis: Verify the shared element exists in both DOM states before calling Flip.from to avoid a silent no-op
dontDoThis: Don't use shared-element transitions across more than one element pair per navigation; compounding Flips are hard to time correctly

doThis: Keep the yPercent delta small (5-15) so foreground and background never desync distractingly
dontDoThis: Don't parallax body copy; it hurts reading comfort and can trigger motion sickness

doThis: Vary speed per layer (background slowest, foreground fastest) to sell the depth illusion
dontDoThis: Don't let parallax layers overflow their container; clip with overflow: hidden on the wrapper

doThis: Use a CSS gradient background-position sweep rather than opacity pulsing; reads as 'loading' more clearly
dontDoThis: Don't run more than one shimmer loop per skeleton group; sync them under one timeline so the wave reads as a single unit

doThis: Cap total loop duration under ~1.5s so long waits don't feel like the UI froze on a single beat
dontDoThis: Don't use elaborate loaders for sub-300ms waits; they flash and feel worse than no indicator
